verdict.rationale: Mixpanel docs explicitly describe creating dashboards composed of saved reports/text cards (mixpanel-docs-11) and marketing copy emphasizes dashboards that teams can align around and keep working from (mixpanel-docs-14, mixpanel-docs-15, mixpanel-docs-22), and community evidence confirms PMs actively build and use custom reports in the UI (mixpanel-comm-12). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dashboard sharing/permission settings for teams, and independent hands-on confirmation of the sharing workflow specifically.
